Telemetry._comment: Set OtlpEndpoint to enable export (e.g. http://localhost:4317). For Aspire Dashboard: docker run -d -p 18888:18888 -p 4317:4317 mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspire-dashboard:latest

Tls._comment: Mode: None (H2C, default), SelfSigned (skip client validation), Standard (trusted CA cert). Set CertificatePath to the .pfx file.
